thread:
maya: kicking off a config-only rollout in the 21:00 UTC change window. No model binaries. Changes: increase routing weight caps (+5%), reduce default_route_timeout from 1200ms -> 900ms, small_batch_timeout 30ms -> 20ms, and change fallback priority to prefer region over cost-tier for latency-sensitive traffic.

liam: checklist: observability queries, canary targets, rollback hooks. I pushed the PromQL and dashboards.

alex: posting thresholds we agree on:
- rollback if error_rate > 0.5% for 5m
- rollback if p99 latency increases > 50ms vs baseline for 10m
- or if routing svc failed_requests > 0.2% absolute
(we should pin the previous routing config for fast revert)

sasha: ramp plan: 10% -> 30% -> 60% -> 100% with 10m observation at each step. If EU shows variance, reduce EU to 5% and pause. :eyes:

maya: ops-bot and I will watch the dashboards. preflight queries:
```
# p99 latency baseline
sum(rate(request_duration_seconds_bucket{job="routing"}[15m])) by (le)
# error rate
sum(rate(requests{job="routing",status!~"2.."}[5m])) / sum(rate(requests{job="routing"}[5m]))
```

deploy-bot: [cfg-rollout-started] id=cfg-2026-03-21-074 agent=deploy-bot type=config-only target=prod change_window=21:00-21:30

ops-bot: preflight checks: all green except slight KV-cache warmup tail in region-eu-1 (metric: kv_cache_warmup_ms higher by ~12%). Not blocking but flagging.

liam: noted. If EU latency climbs, we hold and reduce EU traffic. Also plan to pin routing_config:v0.9.2 as rollback target.

maya: pinned `routing_config:v0.9.2` for immediate rollback. Starting step 1 (10%).

deploy-bot: step 1 (10%) applied at 21:05 UTC — health: ok (10/10 checks passed).

alex: seeing a small error cluster on svc-edge-12 in EU: error spike ~1.2% (5m window) — investigating host logs.

sasha: isolate host, cordon + drain svc-edge-12. Hold the ramp.

maya: holding ramp. if errors don't decline in 2m, we rollback.

deploy-bot: alert: automated health gate failed at 21:07 UTC (error rate > threshold). Initiating rollback to `routing_config:v0.9.2`.

deploy-bot: rollback complete at 21:09 UTC. Post-rollback health: stable.

liam: filing release note in #eng-releases: "config-only deploy 2026-03-21 attempted routing timeout and batching changes; rollback due to transient host error spike in EU. Next steps: smaller EU canary + KV-cache pre-warm adjustments."

maya: thanks all. Follow-up: run a stage-eu soak with kv-cache pre-warm and test with 2% traffic, then re-run during next quiet window.

sasha: +1. I'll create a short playbook with exact PromQL + alert thresholds and link it to the deploy ticket. :white_check_mark:

end
